title: The Spilled Salt in the Butter Dish
youtube_title: The Spilled Salt in the Butter Dish | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Honest words let a friend help with the repair.
summary: At a library table by the round window, Kito is tangled up with a salt spilled in the butter dish and almost hides it. Kito tells Miss Dalca the plain truth, and together they mend what can be mended, with no teasing.
